summary: Recorded reproducibility for the heartbeat race: the clean-copy repeat of the fixed experiment produced 0 inversions in the 200 no-delay attempts and 97 of 200 with 0–2 ms jitter, matching the first run's 0 and 90. The account now cites all three receipts, attributes the counts to the harness delay distribution rather than a field rate, and keeps the caveat that a sub-1/200 rate in the no-delay case remains undetected.
